CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_default_roles_for_business()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO custom_roles (business_id, name, permissions) VALUES
        (NEW.id, 'owner', '{"manage_products": true, "manage_inventory": true, "manage_users": true, "process_sales": true, "view_reports": true, "view_inventory": true, "view_sales": true}'::jsonb),
        (NEW.id, 'manager', '{"manage_products": true, "manage_inventory": true, "manage_users": true, "process_sales": true, "view_reports": true}'::jsonb),
        (NEW.id, 'cashier', '{"process_sales": true, "view_inventory": true}'::jsonb),
        (NEW.id, 'accountant', '{"view_reports": true, "view_sales": true, "view_inventory": true}'::jsonb)
    ON CONFLICT (business_id, name) DO NOTHING;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_business_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN (auth.jwt() ->> 'business_id')::UUID;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN auth.uid();
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_branch_catalog(p_business_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT user_belongs_to_business(p_business_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'categories', COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c))
             FROM categories c
             WHERE c.business_id = p_business_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ),
        'products', COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p))
             FROM products p
             WHERE p.business_id = p_business_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ),
        'inventory', COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i))
             FROM inventory i
             WHERE i.business_id = p_business_id AND i.branch_id = p_branch_id),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_catalog_delta(p_business_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_since timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT user_belongs_to_business(p_business_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'categories', COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c))
             FROM categories c
             WHERE c.business_id = p_business_id
               AND c.updated_at > p_since
               AND c.deleted_at IS NULL),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ),
        'products', COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p))
             FROM products p
             WHERE p.business_id = p_business_id
               AND p.updated_at > p_since
               AND p.deleted_at IS NULL),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ),
        'inventory', COALESCE(
            (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i))
             FROM inventory i
             WHERE i.business_id = p_business_id
               AND i.branch_id = p_branch_id
               AND i.updated_at > p_since),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ),
        'since', p_since
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_ledmi_aggregations()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY mv_daily_sales;
    REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY mv_stock_velocity;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refunded_quantity(p_sale_item_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    total INTEGER;
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ri.quantity), 0)
    INTO total
    FROM refund_items ri
    JOIN refunds r ON r.id = ri.refund_id
    WHERE ri.sale_item_id = p_sale_item_id
      AND r.status = 'completed';

    RETURN total;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_default_roles()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    b businesses%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    FOR b IN SELECT * FROM businesses LOOP
        INSERT INTO custom_roles (business_id, name, permissions) VALUES
            (b.id, 'owner', '{"manage_products": true, "manage_inventory": true, "manage_users": true, "process_sales": true, "view_reports": true, "view_inventory": true, "view_sales": true}'::jsonb),
            (b.id, 'manager', '{"manage_products": true, "manage_inventory": true, "manage_users": true, "process_sales": true, "view_reports": true}'::jsonb),
            (b.id, 'cashier', '{"process_sales": true, "view_inventory": true}'::jsonb),
            (b.id, 'accountant', '{"view_reports": true, "view_sales": true, "view_inventory": true}'::jsonb)
        ON CONFLICT (business_id, name) DO NOTHING;
    END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_belongs_to_business(p_business_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF current_user_id() IS NULL OR p_business_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN false;
    END IF;

    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM user_business_roles
        WHERE user_id = current_user_id()
        AND business_id = p_business_id
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_has_permission(p_business_id uuid, p_permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF current_user_id() IS NULL OR p_business_id IS NULL OR p_permission IS NULL THEN
        RETURN false;
    END IF;

    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM user_business_roles ubr
        JOIN custom_roles cr ON ubr.role_id = cr.id
        WHERE ubr.user_id = current_user_id()
        AND ubr.business_id = p_business_id
        AND cr.permissions ? p_permission
        AND (cr.permissions ->> p_permission)::boolean = true
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_is_owner(p_business_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF current_user_id() IS NULL OR p_business_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN false;
    END IF;

    RETURN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM user_business_roles ubr
        JOIN custom_roles cr ON ubr.role_id = cr.id
        WHERE ubr.user_id = current_user_id()
        AND ubr.business_id = p_business_id
        AND cr.name = 'owner'
    );
END;
$function$
